summary: Identify a local checkpoint several times faster on first start
compatibility: No user action required. The identity is unchanged, so existing caches stay valid.
details: With persistent LMCache storage and a local model directory, the first start hashes the checkpoint to key the cache. Files are now hashed eight at a time with 16 MiB reads (99 GB: 7 s instead of 50 s from page cache), and a log line says what the pause is.
Later starts still reuse the cached result from /cache/checkpoint-identities.
